create_Dyneval_optimizer: create a Dyneval optimizer instance with gradients, variables, learning rate, decay rate, and epsilon
run_Dyneval_update_op: run the Dyneval update operation to apply dynamic evaluation gradient updates with RMSProp-like variance scaling
save_Dyneval_shadow_vars: save the current variable values into Dyneval shadow variables for later restoration
restore_Dyneval_shadow_vars: restore variable values from Dyneval shadow variables after dynamic evaluation
use_Dyneval_context_manager: use Dyneval as a context manager to automatically save and restore variables around a code block
